This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you move everything out of your head and organise it into a simple, elegant structure—clearing unfinished items and reducing mental load. A simple to-do app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make organising, tracking, and completing tasks more satisfying. Get everything done with ease.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform to get the latest episodes first.

News discussed in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 brings back the App Switcher with a new gesture
  • Apple reportedly developing a screenless fitness tracker similar to Whoop
  • What's actually going on with GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack thereof)?
  • Apple ends the unique AR experience at the Apple Park Visitor Center
